exposure: Minimally-invasive surgical approach for Xanthogranulomatous Pyelonephritis (XGP)
Open surgical approach for Xanthogranulomatous Pyelonephritis (XGP)
cohort: The study included 40 patients who underwent nephrectomy for pathologically confirmed Xanthogranulomatous Pyelonephritis (XGP) at a single institution between 2007 and 2017.
finding: Patients undergoing a minimally-invasive surgical approach for XGP experienced less intraoperative blood loss, a lower rate of blood transfusion, reduced postoperative intensive care admission, and a shorter hospital stay compared to those undergoing an open approach.
